scope: W12/L05 hosted detached iOS simulator development attestation verifier

fixture.provenance: A temporary Go test used newBuildFixture, writeDevelopmentKeys and runAttestation from integration_darwin_test.go at the source base. The existing Go executable entry point ran sign and verify in separate subprocesses against a new synthetic IPv4 loopback build fixture. Each subprocess read the exact build detail and all three synthetic products. The captured file is the unchanged signer output.
fixture.readback: Both Go subprocesses exited successfully, performed eight authorized fixture reads in total, and left the same envelope bytes at the retained path.
fixture.controls: The temporary Go test also signed the same statement with a different domain and signed two statement variants with the v1 domain, one with an equivalent JSON escape and one with a different public-key fingerprint. Only public SPKI values, signatures and the detached envelope are in the checkout. The ephemeral keys, state and listener were fixture-owned and cleaned up by the Go test.

verification.output: The temporary fixture test passed. Go sign and verify both passed.
Four existing Go signer tests passed after removal of the temporary fixture test.
Result: 55 passed, including all 8 native development attestation tests

contract: The verifier takes original envelope bytes, an independently authorized ExpectedBuild, and a separately enrolled Ed25519 public SPKI DER.
The caller supplies the configured origin, the completed committed journal selection/revision/attempt, and artifact references and shared capture binding established under server authority.
A successful call is development build evidence. A future attachment caller must establish and fence that authority through persistence.
limitations: Synthetic HTTP producer for Go interop and local ExUnit for Phoenix component behavior.
Hosted API admission, retained-byte lookup composition, Oban signing-request dispatch and durable ledger attachment remain pending.
No OTA, device, deployment, payment, or release qualification.
